```{=html}
<!-- 인트로: 세션당 한 번 재생(assets/intro, scripts/intro_scene.py). 끝나거나 건너뛰면 메뉴가 나타난다. -->
<div id="mml-intro" class="mml-intro" aria-label="인트로 애니메이션">
  <video id="mml-intro-video" muted playsinline preload="auto" poster="assets/intro/intro-poster.png">
    <source src="assets/intro/intro.mp4" type="video/mp4">
  </video>
  <button type="button" class="mml-intro-skip" id="mml-intro-skip">건너뛰기 <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></button>
</div>
<noscript><style>.mml-intro{display:none!important}.mml-reveal{opacity:1!important;transform:none!important}</style></noscript>
<script>
(function () {
  var KEY = "mml-intro-seen";
  var box = document.getElementById("mml-intro");
  var vid = document.getElementById("mml-intro-video");
  var body = document.body;
  var seen = false;
  try { seen = sessionStorage.getItem(KEY) === "1"; } catch (e) {}
  var reduce = window.matchMedia && matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  var finished = false;
  function reveal() { body.classList.add("mml-revealed"); }
  function done() {
    if (finished) return;
    finished = true;
    try { sessionStorage.setItem(KEY, "1"); } catch (e) {}
    box.classList.add("is-out");
    body.classList.remove("mml-intro-on");
    reveal();
    setTimeout(function () { if (box.parentNode) box.parentNode.removeChild(box); }, 900);
  }
  window.mmlReplayIntro = function () {
    try { sessionStorage.removeItem(KEY); } catch (e) {}
    location.reload();
  };
  if (seen || reduce) { box.parentNode.removeChild(box); reveal(); return; }
  body.classList.add("mml-intro-on");
  vid.addEventListener("ended", done);
  vid.addEventListener("error", done, true);
  document.getElementById("mml-intro-skip").addEventListener("click", done);
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) { if (e.key === "Escape" || e.key === "Enter") done(); });
  var p = vid.play();
  if (p && p.catch) p.catch(done);          // 자동 재생이 막히면 바로 메뉴로
  setTimeout(done, 25000);                  // 안전장치
})();
</script>

<section class="mml-hero mml-reveal">
  <p class="mml-eyebrow">Macro Model Lab</p>
  <h1 class="mml-hero-title">거시경제 모형을 직접 돌려 보는 연구실</h1>
  <p class="mml-hero-lead">잠재성장률과 중립금리 추정, 산업연관 분석, 구조 모형까지 — 방법론을 정리하고 실제 자료로 계산합니다.</p>
  <svg class="mml-hero-art" viewBox="0 0 400 120" aria-hidden="true" preserveAspectRatio="none">
    <path class="art-area" d="M0,96 C40,84 60,70 90,78 C120,86 135,104 165,88 C195,72 205,40 240,46 C275,52 285,70 320,58 C350,48 370,36 400,30 L400,40 L0,104 Z"/>
    <path class="art-trend" d="M0,104 L400,40"/>
    <path class="art-gdp" d="M0,96 C40,84 60,70 90,78 C120,86 135,104 165,88 C195,72 205,40 240,46 C275,52 285,70 320,58 C350,48 370,36 400,30"/>
  </svg>
  <button type="button" class="mml-replay" onclick="mmlReplayIntro()">인트로 다시 보기 ↻</button>
</section>
```
